current.headline: THE BUILD, IN MOTION
current.summary: A local-first, owner-controlled AI advancing through verified gates, self-improvement, adaptive hardware control, and a unified runtime while keeping governance and external projects isolated.

roadmap.title: Foundation
roadmap.summary: Independent identity, ownership/provenance records, project structure, and Git foundation.
roadmap.objective: Establish the AI as its own owner-controlled software entity before connecting it to external projects.
roadmap.unlocked: A standalone versioned project with documented identity, ownership intent, provenance, and development rules.
roadmap.evidence: Founding records, project structure, and version-control foundation established.

roadmap.title: Protected Core
roadmap.summary: Owner authority, protected rules, safe startup verification, emergency stop, recovery boundaries, backups, and checkpoints.
roadmap.objective: Create governance the AI cannot silently weaken and preserve owner shutdown/recovery control.
roadmap.unlocked: Verified protected-core startup and recovery boundaries.
roadmap.evidence: Protected-core verification and checkpoint/recovery path passed.

roadmap.title: Infant Learning
roadmap.summary: Persistent memory, experience, skill, failure, and efficiency records plus local conversational model integration.
roadmap.objective: Let the AI accumulate structured experience from its first operational state instead of relying on stateless conversations.
roadmap.unlocked: Persistent learning records and local conversation through Ollama / qwen3:8b.
roadmap.evidence: Memory systems and local-model self-test passed.

roadmap.title: Self-Coding Core
roadmap.summary: Scoped sandbox code generation, testing, repair/evaluation loops, learning records, and protected-core regression.
roadmap.objective: Allow code creation and repair without granting unrestricted access to protected or production code.
roadmap.unlocked: Model-driven sandbox coding with test → fix → retest behavior.
roadmap.evidence: Sandbox self-coding evaluation loop passed with promoted verification, learning-record verification, regression, and checkpoint.

roadmap.title: Research & Computer Tools
roadmap.summary: Source-grounded research and authorized computer/tool interaction foundation.
roadmap.objective: Give the AI controlled access to live research and task tools while preserving permission boundaries.
roadmap.unlocked: Grounded research and authorized tool orchestration.
roadmap.evidence: Research/tool foundation validated under project governance.

roadmap.title: Vision
roadmap.summary: Visual understanding and perception foundation.
roadmap.objective: Enable the AI to interpret visual inputs and screen/image context.
roadmap.evidence: Vision foundation completed.

roadmap.title: Image Creation
roadmap.summary: Image generation and editing workflow foundation.
roadmap.objective: Enable controlled image creation and editing as a replaceable capability module.
roadmap.evidence: Image capability foundation completed.

roadmap.title: Video Creation
roadmap.summary: Video generation and editing workflow foundation.
roadmap.objective: Establish a governed path for future video generation/editing workloads.
roadmap.evidence: Video foundation completed.

roadmap.title: Voice
roadmap.summary: Speech input/output and conversational interaction foundation.
roadmap.objective: Support spoken interaction without making voice services part of the AI's identity.
roadmap.evidence: Voice foundation completed.

roadmap.title: Resource Efficiency
roadmap.summary: Adaptive resource governor, workload admission profiles, and defer behavior for CPU/GPU/RAM/VRAM/power conservation.
roadmap.objective: Keep the AI useful while reducing unnecessary resource use and yielding to higher-priority owner workloads such as gaming.
roadmap.evidence: Adaptive resource governor tests, full regression, protected-core verification, and checkpoint passed.

roadmap.title: Gaming Mode
roadmap.summary: Controlled game-aware operating mode foundation.
roadmap.objective: Allow the AI to coexist with games without becoming a cheating or competitive-advantage tool.
roadmap.evidence: Gaming-mode foundation completed within owner and safety boundaries.

roadmap.title: Discord Integration
roadmap.summary: Bounded Discord integration with explicit permissions and regression/protected-core verification.
roadmap.objective: Support Discord operations without creating an unrestricted external-action channel.
roadmap.evidence: Discord foundation proof, full regression, protected-core verification, and checkpoint passed.

roadmap.title: Game Operations
roadmap.summary: Owned-game operations, moderation, support, and administration foundation.
roadmap.objective: Prepare the AI to assist with games the owner controls while keeping scope explicit.
roadmap.evidence: Game-operations foundation completed.

roadmap.title: Defensive Anti-Cheat
roadmap.summary: Defensive integrity and cheat-detection support for owned games; no player-cheating capability.
roadmap.objective: Detect suspicious behavior for moderation and defense without providing cheating assistance.
roadmap.evidence: Defensive-only foundation completed.

roadmap.title: Agent Factory
roadmap.summary: Scoped specialist/mini-agent creation with inherited protected rules and limited permissions.
roadmap.objective: Create task-specific agents without letting child agents route around governance.
roadmap.evidence: Agent-factory foundation completed with inherited-rule requirements.

roadmap.title: External Project Integration
roadmap.summary: Project isolation plus specialized external agents; THE LONG AFTER Development Agent validated through a controlled sandbox workflow.
roadmap.objective: Connect outside projects without merging their identity/data into the Personal AI or granting uncontrolled production writes.
roadmap.evidence: TLA Development Agent Foundation, Real Workspace Binding, and Controlled TLA Sandbox Coding completed; intentional failure detection, repair + Godot retest, protected-core/regression verification, and real-project fingerprint protection passed.
roadmap.next_action: Complete — direct writes to the real THE LONG AFTER project remain disabled.

roadmap.title: Unified Runtime Foundation
roadmap.summary: Unified the validated foundations behind one runtime while intentionally keeping production self-modification and automatic promotion disabled.
roadmap.objective: Create a deterministic runtime baseline before allowing the AI to evolve itself.
roadmap.unlocked: One clean, versioned runtime foundation ready for controlled improvement.
roadmap.evidence: Deterministic targeted tests PASS; critical-resource defer behavior PASS; unified runtime self-test PASS; full regression PASS; protected-core verification PASS; checkpoint PASS.

roadmap.title: Self-Improvement Engine
roadmap.summary: Controlled self-improvement loop that evaluates candidate changes, rejects regressions, promotes better candidates, and rolls back failed promotions.
roadmap.objective: Move from sandbox self-coding to measurable self-improvement without weakening protected governance.
roadmap.unlocked: Tested candidate evaluation, promotion, rollback, and learning from self-change outcomes.
roadmap.evidence: Worse self-change rejected PASS; better self-change benchmarked/promoted PASS; failed post-promotion validation rollback PASS; learning record PASS; full regression PASS; protected-core verification PASS; checkpoint PASS.

roadmap.title: Adaptive Hardware Optimizer
roadmap.summary: Hardware-aware strategy system that fingerprints the machine, observes pressure, adapts concurrency, learns from outcomes, and falls back safely across hardware differences.
roadmap.objective: Make the AI increasingly efficient on the owner's actual computer and portable across different hardware conditions.
roadmap.unlocked: Dynamic hardware-aware workload strategy and learned resource tuning.
roadmap.evidence: Stable machine fingerprint PASS; CPU/RAM/disk profile PASS; GPU/VRAM discovery/fallback PASS; dynamic pressure strategy PASS; adaptive concurrency PASS; strategy-outcome learning PASS; cross-hardware fallback PASS; full regression PASS; protected-core verification PASS; checkpoint PASS.

roadmap.title: Unified PersonalAI.exe v1
roadmap.summary: Bring the validated v1 runtime capabilities together behind the unified PersonalAI.exe v1 application surface.
roadmap.objective: Move the now-validated runtime, self-improvement, hardware adaptation, controls, and status into the next unified owner-facing application milestone.
roadmap.unlocked: Not yet unlocked — this is the active next milestone.
roadmap.evidence: Waiting on Step 4 implementation and verification.
roadmap.next_action: Begin Step 4 from the clean Step 3 checkpoint and preserve protected-core, regression, rollback, Git-cleanliness, and resource-defer requirements.

future_lanes.title: Advanced Intelligence
future_lanes.summary: Deepen planning, evaluation, memory use, and model/tool orchestration after the unified v1 application milestone.

future_lanes.title: Agent Expansion
future_lanes.summary: Create richer specialist agents while preserving inherited governance and project isolation.

future_lanes.title: Research Expansion
future_lanes.summary: Extend longer-horizon source-grounded research and authenticated resource workflows.

future_lanes.title: Multimodal Expansion
future_lanes.summary: Deepen vision, image, video, voice, and audio workflows as replaceable modules.

future_lanes.title: PC Companion
future_lanes.summary: Increase useful always-available desktop behavior while continuing to reduce idle and foreground resource cost.

future_lanes.title: External Project Operations
future_lanes.summary: Add more isolated external projects using the same sandbox-first integration model.

systems.name: Protected Core

systems.boundary: Project memory remains isolated from global identity.

systems.name: Local Model Runtime
systems.boundary: Model is replaceable and does not define AI identity.

systems.name: Self-Coding Lab
systems.purpose: Generate, test, repair, and evaluate code in controlled copies.
systems.boundary: Protected core and real external projects remain outside unrestricted write scope.

systems.name: Self-Improvement Engine
systems.purpose: Evaluate candidates, reject worse changes, promote better ones, and roll back failures.
systems.boundary: Promotion requires deterministic safeguards and rollback.

systems.name: Adaptive Hardware Optimizer
systems.purpose: Adapt workload strategy to hardware identity and current pressure.
systems.boundary: Yields to owner-priority workloads and cross-hardware fallback rules.

systems.name: Resource Governor
systems.purpose: Admit, defer, or reduce workloads based on CPU/GPU/RAM/VRAM/power pressure.

systems.name: Checkpoints / Recovery
systems.purpose: Create known-good recovery points around significant changes.
